notes.title: Song Beater UI and language update
notes.content:

notes.title: The "BIG UPDATE"! 😍
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/a4e96636fac8f5435ba013511c0c928f3df90198.jpg[/img]

[h3]New graphics[/h3]
[list][*][b]Modern user interface[/b] with always available quick game settings at the bottom
[*][b]Real life boxers promotional photos[/b] for your fitness motivation
[*][b]10 new avatars[/b] for multiplayer and streaming
[*][b]Themes[/b] improved. E.g. Egyptian theme is now populated with even more animals.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/7c3511d91a324a26d10ea6f81623500bda26c8d8.jpg[/img]

[h3]New content[/h3]
[list][*]Brand new game mode called [b]"THE CLUB"[/b] for extreme calories burning and huge scores. Choose any song you want and it will be played in a loop with constantly increasing speed. Hit special bonuses with your head for extra score. (There's a new song called "Welcome to The Club" in Volume 2 which is a good fit for this mode)
[*][b]6 new songs[/b] added to Volume 2 (that makes total 51 songs and videos in the game + 8 custom songs currently available for download from our server + any custom songs in ModSaber format you download from 3rd party servers or create in the provided Song Beater Editor)
[*][b]2 new Steam achievements[/b] for "THE CLUB" mode
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/04de08825e3cff9b6cce86fe26169c4492f5cf04.jpg[/img]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b] now supports [b]voice-chat, custom songs and videos[/b]. You can also change your avatar at any time
[*][b]Progress announcement[/b] during playing the song. If you move up in the leaderboard while playing, you will know it immediately (announced by voice and displayed as yellow number under your score)
[*]Don't know which song to play next? [b]Quick play[/b] button in main menu will select random song for you (song difficulty and source can be changed in settings)
[*][b]Hand rotation[/b] settings. You can rotate your virtual hands to any X/Y/Z angle relative to your real controllers. Also when playing with blades, if you pause the game, you can ajdust angle of the blades using your right thumbstick (touchpad)
[*][b]Real 360[/b] is now more adjustable – choose between whole 360 or 180 degrees, you can also disable vertical angles and keep only horizontal ones
[*][b]Custom songs import[/b] settings. If you downloaded a song in ModSaber format and want to make it easier to play for fitboxing (you can always play it using selection of freestyle weapons as well – blades, saw, tonfas...), you can set recoloring on (this will force beats on the left to have color for your left hand and vice versa), removing beats overlapping each other or moving all the beats up or down whole row for easier reach
[*][b]Custom songs downloading[/b] from our server (and/or other servers you specify in new_patch.txt file) is now more user friendly and allows also deletion of songs
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/fdf7e1367ce0a86cd666936d3c2c0151e8a9fc59.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/cc6b86dc744b0a03a27700ed67e3a08aabb5cd55.jpg[/img]

[h3]New optimizations and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Analysis of your gameplay[/b] in form of accuracy, power & calories burned graphs
[*][b]Score boost[/b] now does not reset to 0 if you fail or miss, only decreases a little bit (based on selected difficulty). Single mishap won't ruin your great score anymore, you can catch up if you try hard enough 
[*][b]Calculations[/b] were reworked – punch or weapon hit detection is now more precise (angle and power of hit, centering on the ball)
[*][b]Improved timing[/b] of several existing songs – even songs with irregular BPM, risers etc. should be now spot on 
[*][b]Player profile[/b] in your party now stores more settings including theme (environment). When you switch to another player, his/her theme loads up automatically
[*][b]Championship mode[/b] now displays list of other players competing with you with their realtime scores (take a look at the floor in front of you), so you always know whether are you winning or need to catch up. Top players will receive points according to their placement
[*][b]Ranking system[/b] (previously separate for Volume 1 and 2 songs) has been merged to single rank with level cap at 180
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/73d421c45788d45230d3faaaad61650fcfe46bed.jpg[/img]

[h3]New competition[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Several new leaderboards[/b] were added – total calories burned, total score for "The Club", total score for "Championship", total score for the other modes. Leaderboard kings now include more game modes as well and weight of difficulties were adjusted (intense and impossibru victories now grants substantially more points than normal, light and gentle)
[/list]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/b524993945104dc518ae0a28d5d81e7342639da2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Real 360 and themes update!
notes.content:
[h3]"Real 360" mode[/h3]
New game mode and environment "Real 360" transports you to center of a high-tech rotating space station. Beats will be coming at you from all directions (including above and below!) but the challenge doesn't stop there. You will be also bombarded by red drones and need to activate your shields (using trigger button) to block them. :-O

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/16c44cef171bba80f7aad3c3595c66dc37fd3eea.jpg[/img]

[h3]Flying dragon theme[/h3]
Brand new theme with moving mountains, fog and lightning. Oh and you are standing on a flying dragon. :)

[h3]Theme enhancements[/h3]
Existing themes have been optimized and improved for better visual experience.

[h3]New settings[/h3]
[list]
[*]Haptic – you can now adjust haptic (vibration) feedback of your controllers (both amplitude and duration) to achieve desired feel
[*]New custom balls art – dealing with coronavirus situation and need something to cheer you up? You can select new virus or biohazard symbols and symbolically destroy these threats the old fashioned way!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/a2bd8da9129781bbeef56bc4a23f449fd8395c35.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 20000 Beats Under the Sea
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Brand new [b]In The Deep[/b] ocean theme filled with wild marine life – corals, jellyfish, octopus, singing whales and small and big fish including sharks circling around sunken ship in front of you :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/6be0e6a8003ede1a9508006d15ad3c0958b45dd1.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Custom songs[/b] tab now allows simple download of new songs from our server. We will keep adding new songs in the future this way without the need to update the whole game. (And for modders out there, you can take advantage of this system, simply replace URL in patch.txt file with your own)

notes.title: Modding update
notes.content:
[h1]Seated/roomscale mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]New setting for [b]seated/roomscale[/b] experience. We are experimenting with autocentering vs respecting roomscale boundaries in SteamVR. When you start the game in "seated" mode the game recenters to your current headset position (and you can also recenter anytime in the game by holding B button or touchpad right for 3 seconds). When in "roomscale" mode, there is no recentering and your position is absolute within your guardian system. [b]Please give it a try and let us know which setting works best for you so we could make it the default[/b] :)
[/list]

[h1]Audio modding[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can replace sounds of individual weapons and of ingame announcements "miss" and "fail". Go to Settings/Modding, set audio modding ON and exit the game. Then replace WAV audiofiles in [b]..\\Song Beater_Data\\Modding\\Audio[/b] directory with your own and start the game again.
[/list]

[h1]Colors modding[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now view/specify colors for beat balls and hands/weapons using precise RGB values along with color wheel.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes and optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Various fixes and optimizations. Improved levels for intense and impossibru difficulty for song Close by Mikalyn (ranked vol. 2).
[/list]

notes.title: Full release update!
notes.content:
After months of constant improving our early access version with regular updates we bring you the ultimate "Full release update", which will pave the way to full release of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/c296e554f87f9c0d99e387d2322f00af66a177ae.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]16 new songs and videos[/b] (so there are now more than 45 songs included in the game!) – Named "volume 2" pack, starring Canadian songwriter and singer Mikalyn, French musician Dizaro and more.
[*][b]3 new game environments[/b] (themes) – Dark tropical island, Deep space and Ancient Egypt. Existing "Early access" theme was improved as well.
[*][b]Championship multiplayer mode[/b] – Want to compete with any number of players all over the world at the same time? Now you can, Championship mode brings automated roster of songs playing non-stop, you can join anytime and select your preferred difficulty level as well (you can see number of players participating in each difficulty, after finishing the song you see your overall placement). If you'd rather play selected song with a chosen friend, you can use existing Multiplayer mode.
[*][b]Further customizations[/b] – You can now change symbols and colors of beat balls (affecting also colors of your hands/weapons) from default yellow-purple scheme to any colors you like. 
[*][b]Optimizations and bugfixes[/b] – Thanks to valuable feedback from our players here on Steam and our Discord server we were able to fix several bugs affecting some achievements. If you still encounter any weird behaviour, let us know at info@songbeater.com
[/list]
Thank you all for your support!
[previewyoutube=VnGlHPXqiLI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update #9 (instant shock)
notes.content:
[h1]Instant shock[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/e4dc14f384c769a713f94c499f64a1376fa3e9f0.jpg[/img]
This new gameplay setting will test your reflexes and reward you with 10% score bonus. When [b]ON[/b], the balls will be spawning in a much shorter distance in front of you thus giving you less time to react. You can think of it as of some kind of martial art practice. :)

[previewyoutube=iQ34PUP8NLI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Camera setting[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35243056/ee9b6e25105916088b5bdbcbfafedd0e00c31817.jpg[/img]
[i](For streaming or showing your gameplay to friends who gather around your monitor/TV/projector :))[/i]

You can now switch between cameras (first person, external static, external moving) and avatar types (Winston or anime character) in the game settings. You can also still use Escape and function (F4 etc.) keys in desktop game window and mouse and arrow keys to adjust the camera view.

notes.title: Update #8 (need for speed)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/c29a764c036a269e965f459c41ef7e6924a283fa.jpg[/img]

[b]3 new game settings[/b]! If you are learning basics of the game or just want to enjoy whole song without the fear of failure, turn "[u]No fail[/u]" option ON (your score won't be saved to leaderboard tables though).

If you just need to take things a little bit slower, adjust brand new "[u]Song speed[/u]" setting to 90% (there will be -10% penalty to your score).

If you are already a pro and want to spice things up, turn the speed all the way up to 150% (you will receive +20% score bonus). And the gameplay becomes quite hilarious as a side effect, see for yourself :-D

[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ni1qhxOH3oY[/url]

If you want to focus on achieving the highest score, you can now setup "[u]Score per hit[/u]" display to show just accuracy (ACC) or just power (POW) of your blows.

notes.title: Multiplayer & promotion!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/230312a7dfb0416581d6a85c4281745628c9358b.jpg[/img]

Update #7 is here with brand new features and announcements:

[h1]Competitive multiplayer[/h1]

You can now compete with your friends or random players by playing the same song at the same time side by side! Whoever wins scores one point to new "Beaters" leaderboard. Ingame footage: https://youtu.be/MA4AMnpHicU

How to play? Select "Fitbox multiplayer" and "Play Random" to enter the lobby. Join another player or create your own room and wait for someone to join you. Use popup menu (B/Y on touch controllers or touchpad right on SteamVR) to leave your current song or room at any time.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/UDtUhx]Discord server[/url] to let us know your thoughts. We will be enhancing and optimizing multiplayer in upcoming updates.

[h1]Sales promotion[/h1]

We are starting 2 weeks long sales promotion now! If you are thinking about trying out Song Beater, this is your chance to get it for the best price! (We plan to transition from early access to full release in September with increasing the price of the game)

We hope to attract new players so that we can test all new features at large scale. So far we have delivered new features and content in weekly updates as promised and hope to continue with improving the game in the future. Will you join us on our journey?

tags.feature: You can now compete with your friends or random players by playing the same song at the same time side by side!

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/a3bedfc68bcc0b6d363c4c8e1843f9f72970ec27.jpg[/img]

[b]Fifth update with new features and content is here![/b]

[list]
[*][u]1 new song[/u] (so we have now 29 total songs!) – Brand new vocal version of popular [b]Bad Love[/b] track by [i]Niwel[/i] 
[*][u]Phasers[/u] enhanced:
– You can now shoot in full auto mode (keep your trigger pressed* and the pulses will be synchronised with song's tempo, you just need to keep aiming)
– Each phaser can hold up to 33 rounds and there are 2 ways to recharge them.
– If you are overwhelmed by incoming balls use your phaser's blade attachment to destroy them in melee combat instead. Each destroyed ball will recharge your phaser with 10 rounds.
– Or bring your phasers together so their blades touch, this way you can fully recharge them in a matter of seconds.
– If you are low on ammo (10 rounds or less) you will hear new voice cue "Recharge"
– *For players with disabilities or if you just don't feel like holding the trigger all the time you can turn Autoshooting ON in game settings.
[*]Players with disabilities can now turn [u]One hand[/u] option ON. Select which hand (left/right) will you use to play, the other hand will be hidden and all spheres will be recolored accordingly. 
[*][u]Obstacles[/u] enhanced – horizontal and vertical moving obstacles now change their position in larger steps and stay there when passing by you so they won't surprise you by moving slightly behind your back.
[*][u]Rotation of spheres[/u] should be more natural in respect to the hand required to destroy them (yellow spheres on the left side should be almost straight while blue spheres would be rotated to intercept your right hand and vice versa)

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/87674274f16f7f59f3bd00614a7752a03bed9a0e.jpg[/img]

[b]Fourth update with new features and content is here![/b]
[list]
[*][u]2 new songs[/u] – [b]Island[/b] by [i]Jarico[/i] and [b]All Night[/b] by [i]Peyruis[/i] 
[*][u]7 existing videos[/u] are now playable as ranked songs as well (so you can choose whether to watch the videoclip in the background or play the song with effects and obstacles instead)
[*][u]Leader kings table[/u] now sorts players based on total points instead of simple victory counts. You get 1 point for each victory in gentle difficulty, 2 for light, 3 for normal, 4 for intense and 5 for impossibru.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/562a5da5fe49bfad122dfe7654e3a6f98f28eaae.jpg[/img]

[*][u]Tonfas[/u] should be easier to handle if you want to perform complex moves such as rotating the longer end in front of you.
[*][u]Staff[/u] can now be held in any hand. Bring your hands together to move it to your other hand.
[*][u]Tonfas and staff[/u] will give you best score if you cut the balls in half (similar to blades) instead of just destroying them
[*][u]Blades[/u] game uses 30% bigger balls for easier cutting
[*][u]Score per hit[/u] can show percentage (of ideal hit) instead of score number. You can enable it in Settings/Game.
[*][u]Head collider[/u] is now smaller so avoiding obstacles should be easier.
[*][u]Custom sounds[/u] – if you want to experiment with sounds for fit boxing or different weapons, you can enable Modding in Settings and replace ".wav" files in \Song Beater\Song Beater_Data\Modding\Audio folder
[/list]

[b]Third update with new features and content is here![/b]
[list]
[*][u]4 new songs[/u] – [b]When You're Comin' Back Around[/b] (videoclip) by [i]Norwall[/i], [b]Rollercoaster [/b] by [i]Declan DP[/i], [b]I Saw a Ghost Last Night[/b] by [i]Leonell Cassio[/i]... and [b]Sven[/b] by [i]Party In Backyard[/i] with special minecraft-like treatment, check it out! :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/686917d470c41ee6498c245335ce6c15f5d15d0d.jpg[/img]

[*][u]Laser obstacles[/u] – Several different types of horizontal and vertical obstacles coming at you, some of them even moving from side to side or up and down! :) They now appear automatically in all ranked and custom songs (not videos), you get +10% score bonus for them. You can turn obstacles off in game settings, but you will lose this score bonus so choose wisely. ;)
[*][u]Life bar and song progress bar[/u] – Your life bar (which was previously placed in front of your feet) is now placed on the left side above boost number so you can see it all the time. We have also added song progress bar, you can see it on the right above calories meter. Song name, length and artist name remain displayed at your feet.
[*][u]Score per hit display[/u] – If you have this setting turned on, you can see individual score for each hit. For multiple hits in a quick succession you can now see their sum.
[*][u]Blades adjustments[/u] – Blades are now positioned more naturally from previous "Wolverine" position, which was fun to watch, but hard to master. :) The balls now show cross on them. If you slice the ball horizontally or vertically right at the cross you get extra boost score.
[*][u]Custom videos support[/u] – Custom songs created or converted to Song Beater format (sb.json) now support MP4 video playback. If you want to try it out, edit your song's sb.json file with any text editor and rename "audio" property to "video" and replace ".ogg" filename in there with your ".mp4" file (or you can keep the audio tag and add video as new – in that case your song will appear both on Custom songs and Videos tab so you can choose in the game whether to play it with video background or not). See our sample song "Song Beater – Retro Beats" in "CustomSongs" which now has both audio and video version.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[b]First update with new features and content is here![/b]
[list]
[*][u]4 new songs[/u] – newest single [b]Triumphant[/b] by [i]Axl & Arth feat. Dustin Paul[/i], [b]Something for Nothing[/b] by [i]Jimmy Burney, Alundra[/i] in Videos section; [b]This way[/b] by [i]Scomber[/i] in Ranked songs; [b]Retro Beats[/b] by [i]Mem[/i] in Custom songs (if you are interested in creating your own songs, you can open this one in level editor for an inspiration :)).
[*][u]Ranking system[/u] – you are now rewarded for playing ranked songs (in fit boxing mode in normal, intense or impossibru difficulty). Your total score in ranked songs determines your current rank level
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/d5199365e5fce0dffb2db400f5d4682fdff43ed3.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35243056/a2b1487b4be0294e1536ceca442d1ff59e0e6eee.jpg[/img][/url]
[*][u]Leader glory[/u] – when you or any other player place at the top of the leaderboard, all players in the world are notified about this extraordinary achievement (so they can either pause in awe or try to beat your score right away ;))
[*][u]Free Style adjustments[/u] – we are improving behaviour of individual weapons and their effects. Saw now halves the balls with higher precision, we plan to focus on blades next.
[/list]

[b]New settings and adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]We have listened to your feedback and added 2 new settings in the game. Let us know how they work for you or if you experience any issues, thank you!
– Settings/Game/[u]Debris reduction[/u] – when enabled, this will reduce the amount of graphical effects and emitted particles while playing so that you could focus better on oncoming balls without too much distraction
– Settings/Profile/[u]Spawner height[/u] – if you feel the balls are flying over your head (literally ;)) and normal recentering of the game (by holding B button) doesn't cut it for you, you can use this setting to move all the balls down (-) or up (+) by any amount of centimeters. This setting should also help if you are having wrong height/floor issues with your headset.
[*]We have adjusted balls [u]grid size for intense and impossibru[/u] difficulty levels to make them more enjoyable without the need to jump all over the place. :) Impossibru was shrinked from 120×120 cm to 100×100, intense was shrinked from 90×90 to 80×80. Normal, gentle and light remain the same, 60×60.
[*]We have added [u]more spacing between near balls[/u] for Custom songs in ModSaber format running directly from Song Beater (i.e. not edited in our level editor). The balls should now intersect significantly less. :)
[*]There is now [u]higher chance (50->75%) for correct letters in Letter Hunter[/u] mode, meaning if you are able to spot the letters in time, you can construct the sentences much quicker.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Letter Hunter – there was one misbehaving ball on the right side with slightly rotated letters. We hired a new one for this job. Also sometimes when you hit correct letter it was ignored for the sentence, this should now be fixed.
[*]Special Steam achievement "I see dead people" activated in game might not have been saved in your steam profile. When you run this updated version of the game, the achievement should be activated for you automatically.
[*]Player weight (which is used to calculate calories) might not have been saved correctly in your profile. Please go to your Settings/Profile and double check.
[/list]

Next update is planned for friday 7/19. We have already secured at least 2 new songs (one of them is great [b]Minute[/b] by [i]Dizaro[/i]) so stay tuned...

If you are interested in the development of the game, have ideas, comments, please join us on our Discord server. Thank you for your support! :) [url]https://discord.gg/2cPXfwx[/url]
